thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated 5xx rate + p95 latency on hosted-us-west-2 for /v1/generate. Approx 15% error rate, started ~03:12 UTC. On-call: Alex.

Alex: on it, joining bridge now — dialing in. pulling up logs and request traces.

Maria: I can join infra bridge, checking GPU pod health and node autoscale history. any indication of a deploy?

Jon: CI/deploy-bot shows no model push in the last 2 hours. last deploy: 03:14 UTC but that was a small infra tweak to nginx timeouts (PR #4821). not sure if related.

Sasha: I'm taking IC. quick triage threads: 1) traffic spike/overload, 2) backend KV cache thrash, 3) model runtime regressions. let's instrument in that order. Alex/Lee please grab traces and tail router logs. Maria, check node readiness and OOMs.

Lee: tailing router logs now. seeing big spike in requests from a single customer org (org_id=acme-inc) ~03:11-03:13, 4x baseline. Also increased KV eviction logs around same time.

Alex: confirming p95 climbs correlate with retries to model backend and 502/503 originating from inference workers. KV eviction counts up. suspect KV hotkey causing cache miss storms.

Maria: infra view: autoscaler spawned 6 pods in last 5m but they fail LivenessProbe on startup (error from /health: 502). GPU nodes report transient gRPC errors to kv-store. no OOMs.

Sasha: mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit offending org at router level 2) disable autoscale to stop flapping 3) roll back nginx timeout change if it looks related 4) fallback to smaller model variant for critical routes. we will do 1 and 2 now.

Alex: applying temporary rate-limit for org=acme-inc -> 50rps. will post config snippet.

Alex: ```
# temp-rate-limit
route: /v1/generate
match: org_id=acme-inc
limit: 50rps
duration: 1h
```

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Rate-limit rule applied by Alex at 03:21 UTC.

Maria: disabling cluster autoscaler now to stop churn. keeping current pods.

ops-bot: :warning: Autoscaler paused by Maria at 03:22 UTC.

Lee: seeing immediate reduction in pod churn; error rate dropping from 15% -> 6% over last 2m. p95 still elevated but trending down.

Jon: can we enable prefix/KV caching fallback for affected models? quick patch available in prod-config, can toggle to prefer cache hits.

Sasha: go for it, Jon. prioritize safest change first. avoid any disruptive restarts.

Jon: toggled cache-fallback=true for model: rdx-large at 03:25 UTC.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: config change applied by Jon.

Alex: latency now stabilizing, errors down to 2-3%. I recommend we keep rate-limit and cache-fallback for 1 hour, then evaluate.

Sasha: agreed. marking incident as mitigated. moving to post-incident workflow.

Sasha: immediate action items (DRI in parens):
- ACTION: Create postmortem doc and schedule RCA meeting (Sasha).
- ACTION: Add hotkey detection + automatic throttling to runbook (Jon).
- ACTION: Revisit autoscaler safety checks to avoid liveness-related restarts (Maria).
- ACTION: Validate nginx timeout rollback impact and if needed revert PR #4821 (Lee).
- ACTION: Reach out to ACME support and notify customer impact (Alex).

Alex: I'll draft customer note and poke ACME contact. linking internal ticket: ENG-2418 (Post-incident: us-west KV hotkey).

Sasha: scheduling: propose 48h postmortem meeting Thursday 03/21 16:00 UTC. attendees: Alex, Maria, Jon, Lee, infra leads. Sasha DRI.

Maria: I'll own the autoscaler follow-up. putting a blocker card in backlog and will attach logs.

Jon: I'll add runbook patch. draft snippet for hotkey mitigation:```
- detect: kv_evictions > X in 1m
- action: apply per-org rate-limit 10% of baseline or cap at 100rps
- notify: pager and create incident channel
```

Sasha: good. also we need improved telemetry to tie high-error sessions to origin orgs earlier — ops-observability ticket ENG-2420.

ops-bot: :information_source: Incident mitigated at 03:30 UTC. Summary: KV cache hotkey from single org caused autoscale churn + backend failures -> temporary rate-limit + cache-fallback + pause autoscaler mitigated.

Alex: closing bridge, handing off to post-incident. I'll post the draft postmortem link by EOD.

Sasha: thanks team. postmortem owners: Sasha (lead), Alex (customer comms), Jon (runbook), Maria (autoscaler), Lee (nginx/config). Please update action statuses in ENG-2418.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident channel archived and ticket ENG-2418 created. Reminder: add PRACTICE tag if you'd like to schedule a war-room simulation for this scenario.

Alex: noted. few quick follow ups: add a runbook section for "hotkey-induced eviction" and include a blocklist flow for orgs with repeat incidents.

Sasha: assigning that to Jon in the doc. we'll reconvene in 48h. closing thread. :thumbsup:
